tasks.goal: Patrol Charter Hall perimeter on forest trail surface, stopping at charter display kiosks for signage inspection.
tasks.terrain: Uneven dirt and gravel path with tree roots and rock outcrops typical of the Boundary Waters forest edge; wooden boardwalk sections near the entrance.
success: Visits all 5 kiosk waypoints within +/-0.3 m
Mean speed kept at or below 0.8 m/s on boardwalk
Zero collisions logged in /scan minimum-distance check
safety_stops: Stop if lidar detects obstacle under 0.5 m
E-stop on boardwalk edge detection via roll angle >15 deg
Stop for any pedestrian within 1.5 m corridor
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the patrol route and reviews any anomaly flagged at kiosks.

tasks.goal: Retrieve research binders from shelving units and deliver them to the synthesis desk.
tasks.terrain: Flat lab floor with cable runs between desks and low step at doorway threshold; shelf clearance 0.6 m aisles.
success: Grasp success rate at or above 90 percent over 10 trials
Place position error under 2 cm on desk
No dropped-object events
safety_stops: Abort grasp if object not detected in 5 s
Stop arm if joint torque exceeds threshold
Halt if human enters 1 m workspace radius
tasks.human_in_loop: A researcher confirms correct binder selection before final place.

tasks.goal: Act as telepresence moderator assistant, moving between debate pods and displaying proposal summaries to participants.
tasks.terrain: Carpeted forum floor with chair legs, podium steps (7 cm riser), and crowd flow lanes between pods.
success: Reaches 4 pod stations within +/-0.2 m
Speech prompts play at each pod with under 1 s latency
Zero tip events on step transitions
safety_stops: Stop if IMU tilt exceeds 20 deg
Stop for obstacle within 0.4 m
Dock at battery under 15 percent
tasks.human_in_loop: A human moderator approves when each proposal summary is displayed.

tasks.goal: Carry task-routing documents and small supplies between the Task Router station and working group tables.
tasks.terrain: Rubberized deck flooring with cable trays, table legs clusters, and occasional wet boot zones near exterior door.
success: Completes 8 delivery runs with under 0.25 m goal error
Load (1.5 kg tote) retained on all runs
No slip events on wet-zone crossings logged by IMU
safety_stops: Stop if lidar obstacle under 0.3 m
Crouch-stop if IMU detects slip signature
Return to dock if battery under 20 percent
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves each delivery manifest before dispatch.

tasks.goal: Climb the observatory's steep forest-side stair to inspect progress-board lighting and mounted sensors at height.
tasks.terrain: Wooden stair with 30-degree incline, wet timber treads after rain, exposed tree roots and loose gravel at base, forest canopy shade affecting vision.
success: Ascends and descends 12 steps with no foot slips logged in /foot_contacts
Captures 6 inspection images with exposure above quality threshold
Maintains body attitude within 10 deg of stair pitch
safety_stops: Sit-down stop if any foot slip exceeds 5 cm
Abort if battery under 20 percent before ascent
Stop if human detected within 1 m on stair
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator approves ascent start and reviews captured inspection images.

tasks.goal: Fly a low-altitude indoor scan mapping CO2 and humidity across the lab to verify ventilation for long agent work sessions.
tasks.terrain: Ceiling-mounted ducts and pendant lights at 2.7 m; desk clusters and shelf tops up to 1.8 m creating tight vertical corridors.
success: Completes 5m x 4m grid scan at 3 altitude bands within 8 minutes
Maintains position error under 0.15 m using range sensors
No wall or furniture contact events
safety_stops: Land immediately if range sensor reads under 0.4 m
Land if battery under 20 percent
Cut motors if pose estimate variance exceeds threshold
tasks.human_in_loop: A lab steward approves flight plan and confirms the lab is clear of people.

tasks.goal: Precision-mount printed proposal posters onto the forum wall grid at fixed mounting heights.
tasks.terrain: Wall grid panel with bolt-head protrusions (2 cm) and floor cable raceway limiting base placement to 0.4 m from wall.
success: Mounting position error under 5 mm at all 6 grid slots
Contact force during press under 10 N
Cycle time per poster under 45 s
safety_stops: Stop if end-effector wrench exceeds 20 N
Stop if human enters collaborative workspace zone
Reduced-speed mode within 15 cm of wall
tasks.human_in_loop: A person verifies each poster alignment before adhesive press.
